Esri India Launches Free Digital Atlas Program to Make School Geography Genuinely Interesting

2026-09-08 Aasthaa Bhandari (Gadget Bridge) Esri India, ArcGIS Online, digital atlas, schools, geography education, GIS, spatial thinking, ed-tech
Read the source article

Quick summary

Esri India launched a free Digital Atlas Program built on ArcGIS Online, giving schoolteachers interactive mapping tools to transform geography from memorization to real-world investigation.

Key takeaways

  • Esri India launched the Digital Atlas Program, offering interactive digital mapping tools and curriculum-relevant content free to schools across India
  • Built on ArcGIS Online, the program provides interactive tools to explore layers of real-world data: population patterns, weather, land use, and more
  • The initiative shifts students from asking "where is it" to "why is it there," examining real-world events like flooding through data
  • GIS in classrooms has been linked to measurable gains in analytical skills and stronger STEM performance
  • The program targets spatial and geographic literacy — skills that underpin urban planning, disaster management, and climate science
